About the College
Rooted in
Orang, Serving Assam
Kalaguru Bishnu Rabha Degree College was set up in the heart of Orang Chariali in 1990 after the name of renowned Bishnu Prasad Rabha, the mentor of culture and father of socio-economic revolution in Assam, by some of the economically weak but ever conscious and far-sighted people of Orang area with the help of public donation.
The college has emerged as the only institution imparting quality higher education to thousands of students belonging to different caste and communities and especially the tribal and non-tribals covering the vast area of the undivided Darrang district, despite several economic and social hazards.

Campus Life
College
Facilities
Library
A properly equipped library meeting students' greater need for information, offering a large number of academic materials and resources.
Department Laboratories
Spaces for department laboratories allowing students to practice on various subjects with hands-on learning facilities.
Sports & Gym
A provision for sports and gym to ensure that physical health is given much attention in addition to academic achievement.
IT Infrastructure
Good investments in IT equipment that improve technological learning, recognising the role of technology in the current society.
Hostels
Both male and female hostel facilities available to house students who prefer living in college accommodation on the 16-acre campus.
NSS & NCC Units
Active NSS and NCC units working on community outreach, voter awareness, and social service programmes.
